aggregation:
Aggregate v3 raw records into machine-readable summaries and paper tables/figures.

Aggregation: each case contributes one value per quantity = median over its
three repeats; across cases we report the median of per-case values or
per-case paired ratios, with the interquartile range and full range. These
are descriptive statistics over a small, non-random set of workloads, not
confidence intervals.
